name: Ladonia Residence, Kosinožići
summary: Ladonia Residence, a few minutes from Poreč: the first three of eight buildings, five flats in each, every one furnished. Buildings A and B — two wings in khaki render under a stone-clad box on the roof, louvred pergolas over the ground-floor gardens, an outside stair up to the first-floor flats, whose own stairs climb into the box and out onto roof terraces with a jacuzzi, an outdoor kitchen and planters of grasses; B with a pool in front. Building C — banded in corten over sand render, a stone-clad recess through both floors on each side. Parking on the street behind dry-stone walls and photinia, the oak woods behind.
